question: Is the site certified to ISO 9001 (or IATF 16949 / AS9100 / ISO 13485) by an accredited certification body?
Are quality objectives set and reviewed by top management?
Is there an internal audit programme covering all processes, with findings closed?
Is there a named quality contact with authority to stop shipment?
Are customer drawings, specifications and revision levels reviewed before order acceptance?
Are special characteristics and customer-specific requirements flowed to production?
Is capacity checked before accepting orders and delivery dates?
Are sub-tier suppliers selected and evaluated against defined criteria?
Are customer requirements (including special processes and approved sources) flowed down on purchase orders?
Is incoming material verified (inspection or certificates) before use?
Are work instructions and control plans available and current at the point of use?
Is first-piece / set-up approval done and recorded before each run?
Are special processes (heat treatment, plating, welding, soldering, sterilization) validated and monitored?
Is preventive maintenance planned and recorded for critical equipment?
Are key characteristics monitored with SPC and reacted to?
Are all gauges and test equipment calibrated and traceable to national standards?
Is final inspection performed and recorded before shipment?
Has MSA (Gage R&R) been done for gauges used on key characteristics?
Can the site produce the inspection reports or CoCs the customer requires?
Is nonconforming product identified and segregated so it cannot be shipped?
Are customers notified and concessions obtained before shipping deviating product?
Are root causes analysed (8D, 5 Why) and effectiveness verified?
Are customer complaints answered within the required time?
Can finished product be traced to material lots and process records?
Are storage conditions, shelf life and FIFO controlled?
Is packaging defined and adequate to protect the product?
Is on-time delivery measured and acted on?
